diagnosis: Systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving skin
legend: A dense lymphoid infiltrate involving the superficial and deep dermis with a wedge-shaped pattern is seen. The infiltrate extends into the subcutaneous fat.

diagnosis: Systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving skin
legend: An infiltration of atypical lymphocytes in the epidermis is observed.

diagnosis: Systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving skin
legend: Atypical lymphocytes within the epidermis and dermis are highlighted by CD30.

diagnosis: Systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving skin
legend: The atypical lymphocytes within the epidermis and dermis express the cytotoxic protein perforin.

diagnosis: Systemic ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving skin
legend: There is a perivascular distribution of neoplastic lymphoid cells, which show a nuclear and cytoplasmic expression of ALK, consistent with the presence of an NPM1::ALK fusion gene.
